verdicts.rationale: Bug CONFIRMED: Milvus COSINE metric returns distance 1.0000001192092896 > 1.0 for identical normalized vectors, violating the mathematical invariant that cosine distance ∈ [-1, 1]. Root cause: CosineImplPure function in pkg/util/distance/calc_distance.go (lines 44-54) computes cosine distance but doesn't clamp the result to [-1, 1] before returning. Due to floating-point precision imprecision in the dot product and square root operations, results can exceed the theoretical boundary. Reproduced on v2.6.12 with exact test case from GitHub issue #49059 using 128-dimensional vectors. This is a genuine numerical precision bug, not a test setup error or API misunderstanding.
